title: Preliminary Appraisal, Chapter One: The Detours toward Determining the Essence of Philosophy (Metaphysics), and the Unavoidability of Looking Metaphysics in the Face
coverage_sections: Preliminary Appraisal, Chapter One, §§1-3 (the Novalis hinge: philosophy as homesickness, Heimweh as the fundamental attunement of philosophizing, and the world/finitude/individuation triad)
source: Martin Heidegger, The Fundamental Concepts of Metaphysics: World, Finitude, Solitude (GA 29/30), trans. William McNeill & Nicholas Walker, Indiana University Press, 1995
focus: boredom (this unit grounds the philosophy-as-attunement frame on which the later boredom analysis depends; no boredom analysis occurs yet)

structural_role: Opening unit of the course. Closes off every external route to defining philosophy (science, worldview, art, religion, history) and re-determines philosophy from out of itself as philosophizing, a fundamental occurrence in the ground of human Dasein that always happens within a Grundstimmung. Takes its lead from Novalis's fragment to name homesickness (Heimweh) as that fundamental attunement, and from homesickness derives the world/finitude/individuation triad and the conception of metaphysical concepts as comprehensive concepts (Inbegriffe). This is the seedbed for the entire boredom spine: the later awakening of profound boredom is the concrete cashing-out of the philosophy-as-attunement thesis laid down here.

sections.title: The incomparability of philosophy — neither science nor the proclamation of a worldview (a: neither science nor worldview, p.1; b: not via the detour through art and religion, p.2; c: the historical-orientation escape route as an illusion, p.3)

Determining philosophy from out of itself, taking a lead from a word of Novalis (a: the withdrawal of metaphysics into the obscurity of the essence of man, p.4; b: homesickness as the fundamental attunement of philosophizing, and the questions of world, finitude, individuation, p.5)
Metaphysical thinking as comprehensive thinking: dealing with the whole and gripping existence through and through

key_terms.gloss: Heimweh — the fundamental attunement of philosophizing, glossed from Novalis as 'an urge [Trieb] to be at home everywhere'; possible only because we who philosophize are not at home everywhere.
Grundstimmung — the mood out of which our being-gripped and philosophical comprehension necessarily arise; philosophy in each case happens in a fundamental attunement, in the ground of human Dasein.
Ergriffenheit / ergriffen — being seized by what concepts are to comprehend; all such being gripped comes from and remains in an attunement; conceptual comprehension (Begreifen) is grounded in it.

Inbegriff (pl. Inbegriffe) — metaphysical concepts that comprehend the whole within themselves and, in a second equally essential sense, comprehend the comprehending human being (Dasein); not universals.
the being-there in human beings of which 'animal, dupe of civilization, guardian of culture, personality' are only shadows; metaphysics is a fundamental occurrence within human Dasein.
Holzwege — the detours (Umwege) are 'really false trails', paths that suddenly stop and lead up a blind alley; the figure for science/worldview/art/religion/history as routes to philosophy.

Begreifen / Begriff(e) — the 'hammer' of primordial concepts that open a path for the metaphysical questions; a determinative representation for science but, for metaphysics, anchored in being-gripped.

Trieb — translator's term (more literally 'drive' / 'instinctual drive'); Trieb and cognates (treiben, vertreiben, etc.) are prominent in both the boredom analysis and the animality analysis of the course.
πολλὰ ψεύδονται ἀοιδοί — Aristotle, Metaphysica A 2, 983a3f., cited as the objection that Novalis is 'merely a poet', then set aside: art is the sister of philosophy.

claims.text: To judge philosophy by the idea of science is 'the most fateful debasement of its innermost essence'; philosophy is neither science nor the proclamation of a worldview, and can be determined only from out of itself.

Comparison cannot reach philosophy: art and religion stand on a level equal to it, yet we can differentiate them from philosophy only once we have already 'looked philosophy in the face'; so that route too is closed.
The historical-orientation route harbours the 'greatest illusion', pretending that historical knowledge of opinions about metaphysics gives us metaphysics itself; it leads to a dead end.
Philosophy is philosophizing: it is only whenever we are philosophizing, a human activity in the ground of the essence of human Dasein, into whose obscurity metaphysics withdraws.

Novalis: 'Philosophy is really homesickness, an urge to be at home everywhere'; Heidegger takes this poet's word, not deceptive if we extract what is essential, as naming the fundamental attunement of philosophizing.
To be at home everywhere means 'to be at once and at all times within the whole'; this 'within the whole' and its character of wholeness is named the world.

Our very being is restlessness: driven toward being as a whole yet simultaneously torn back; we ourselves are this 'underway', this 'neither the one nor the other'; the unrest of this 'not' is named finitude.
In becoming finite there occurs an individuation of man with respect to his Dasein — not ego-clinging but the solitariness in which each human being first enters a nearness to world.
Conceptual philosophical comprehension is grounded in our being gripped, and this in turn is grounded in a fundamental attunement; philosophy in each case happens in a fundamental attunement.
The question 'What is metaphysics?' transforms into the question 'What is man?'; man becomes more enigmatic, yet in the essence of this mysterious being philosophy happens.

Metaphysics is a fundamental occurrence within human Dasein, not a discipline alongside others; its fundamental concepts are comprehensive concepts (Inbegriffe) that comprehend both the whole and the comprehending human being.
Metaphysical thinking is comprehensive thinking in a double sense: it deals with the whole and it grips existence through and through, the questioners being placed into question.

interlocutors.name: Novalis (Friedrich von Hardenberg)
interlocutors.role: Primary lead-witness: the fragment 'Philosophy is really homesickness, an urge to be at home everywhere' (Schriften, ed. Minor, 1923, vol. 2, p.179, Frgm. 21) supplies the word from which Heidegger derives Heimweh as fundamental attunement and the world/finitude/individuation triad. Conceded to be 'merely a poet', then vindicated.

interlocutors.name: Aristotle
interlocutors.role: Cited as the standing objection to the poet-witness — Metaphysica A 2, 983a3f., 'πολλὰ ψεύδονται ἀοιδοί', 'Poets tell many a lie' — then set aside without provoking an argument over authority.

interlocutors.name: Descartes
interlocutors.role: Named as the marker of the beginning of modernity, the point since which philosophy has vainly attempted to raise itself to the rank of absolute science.

bridge_relevance: No direct bridge relevance to the King–Salvo empirical boredom pipeline beyond grounding philosophy-as-attunement: this unit installs the Grundstimmung apparatus (philosophy happens only within a fundamental attunement) that the later profound-boredom analysis presupposes, but contains no boredom analysis and no empirically mappable structural moments.
